body.heading: Where in the world is Mozambique?
paragraphs: Mozambique is a country in Eastern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Mozambique is Maputo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Mozambique is Portuguese.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Mozambique is the Mozambican metical.

body.heading: How big is Mozambique?
paragraphs: Mozambique covers about 802,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Gabon.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: These sandy islands off Vilanculos have dunes, coral reefs and dugongs grazing in seagrass meadows — families snorkel with turtles and manta rays in glass-clear water.
Gorongosa, at the foot of its own mountain, is one of Africa's great wildlife comebacks — lions, elephants and hippos thrive again on its floodplains.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Mozambique on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
